marta: Quick follow-up: proposal for a compact lease token grammar that preserves auditability while keeping payload small. idea sketch below.
kevin: short is good. can you show exact fields we need to encode?
marta: minimal set: lease_epoch (date), affinity_flag (enum: hard|soft), soft_ttl_hours, origin_id (short), kid for signature. e.g. compact: `E20240901.AS.T24.Octl.k3.sfx` then base36-encode the whole thing.
owen: two operational requirements: 1) servers must log decoded full metadata for audit, 2) if decode fails, do not change routing semantics. fall back to resolver.
jin: auth: require HMAC prefix + kid. unsigned tokens accepted as hints only. signed tokens enable strict routing.
ops-bot: note: add runbook toggle `X-RW-IGNORE-COMPACT-LEASE:1` to bypass compact decoding in incidents.
marta: action items: 1) Kevin prototype encoder/decoder, 2) Jin spec key rotation and sig truncation, 3) Owen telemetry for decode_fail and signed_accept_count, 4) Marta will add examples to RFC. will open PR.
